title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 9 — WORLD 7: C1+ BUSINESS, ECONOMICS & FINANCIAL INTELLIGENCE
grammar: Formal analytical writing for business and economics
Advanced cause, consequence, contrast, and concession structures
Modality, probability, forecasting, and risk language
Complex conditionals for financial and strategic scenarios
Comparative and evaluative structures for competing options
Nominalisation, compression, and concise professional reporting
Hedging, evidence attribution, and responsible financial claims
Register adaptation for clients, executives, investors, and public audiences

missions.title: Business & Finance Calibration
missions.focus: Diagnose advanced business and financial language while distinguishing commercial facts, assumptions, forecasts, and opinions.

missions.title: Economic Vocabulary Forge
missions.focus: Use precise C1+ vocabulary for markets, firms, growth, productivity, finance, trade, incentives, and economic policy.

missions.title: Market Systems Observatory
missions.focus: Analyse market structures, competition, incentives, barriers to entry, and how firms respond to changing conditions.

missions.title: Supply & Demand Simulator
missions.focus: Explain shifts in supply and demand, pricing effects, elasticity, shortages, surpluses, and market responses.

missions.title: Inflation & Interest Rate Lab
missions.focus: Discuss inflation, interest rates, purchasing power, monetary policy, and their effects using cautious analytical language.

missions.title: Financial Statements Decoder
missions.focus: Interpret the language and basic relationships of income statements, balance sheets, cash flow, revenue, costs, assets, and liabilities.

missions.title: Budgeting & Cash-Flow Mission
missions.focus: Build and explain realistic budgets, cash-flow forecasts, financial priorities, and trade-offs for individuals or organisations.

missions.title: Risk & Uncertainty Arena
missions.focus: Evaluate financial and business risks, communicate uncertainty, and compare mitigation strategies without overclaiming.

missions.title: Entrepreneurship Strategy Studio
missions.focus: Develop a business idea, identify customer needs, assess feasibility, and explain competitive advantages and constraints.

missions.title: Business Model Architecture
missions.focus: Analyse value propositions, customer segments, revenue models, operating costs, partnerships, and scalable business systems.

missions.title: Global Trade Nexus
missions.focus: Discuss international trade, supply chains, exchange rates, tariffs, comparative advantage, and cross-border business decisions.

missions.title: Investment & Compound Growth Lab
missions.focus: Explain basic investment concepts, returns, compounding, diversification, time horizons, and risk using responsible language.

missions.title: Sustainable Finance Forum
missions.focus: Evaluate sustainability, ESG-related claims, responsible investment, long-term value, and the limits of simplified sustainability narratives.

missions.title: Economic Data Interpretation
missions.focus: Interpret tables, charts, indicators, trends, correlations, and uncertainty while avoiding unsupported conclusions.

missions.title: Professional Report Writing
missions.focus: Write a structured executive report that synthesises evidence, compares options, explains implications, and gives clearly qualified recommendations.

missions.title: Negotiation & Deal-Making Arena
missions.focus: Use advanced language for negotiation, concessions, priorities, objections, clarification, agreement, and strategic compromise.

missions.title: Investor Pitch Command
missions.focus: Deliver a persuasive but evidence-aware business pitch covering the problem, solution, market, model, risks, and growth plan.

missions.title: Crisis & Reputation Management
missions.focus: Respond to a business crisis with precise public communication, stakeholder analysis, corrective action, and reputation-sensitive language.

missions.title: World 7 Integration Quest
missions.focus: Integrate business reading, economic listening, data analysis, financial reasoning, report writing, negotiation, and presentation skills.

missions.title: C1+ Business & Financial Intelligence Master Challenge
missions.focus: Solve an integrated business and financial scenario using evidence-based analysis, risk language, strategic communication, and ethical decision-making.

realWorldScenarios.title: Startup Strategy Room
realWorldScenarios.description: Evaluate a startup opportunity, analyse its business model and risks, interpret market information, and present a defensible growth strategy.

realWorldScenarios.title: Personal Finance Planning Desk
realWorldScenarios.description: Create a realistic financial plan involving budgeting, cash flow, savings goals, uncertainty, and long-term trade-offs using responsible financial language.

realWorldScenarios.title: Global Market Briefing
realWorldScenarios.description: Prepare and deliver a briefing on changing economic conditions, international trade, business risks, and possible strategic responses for a global organisation.

assessment.type: Integrated business, economics, and financial intelligence assessment
